name: thesis-mcwm-headway-td-v17
interpretation: Paired model-TD usage intervention on v16 mc_state. Retain model fitting, generation, RNG isolation, same-vehicle headway rewards and all observed training settings. The zero arm removes the model TD gradient, not the model fitting cost. Reuse v16 mc_state (0.25), H2O+ and rules as references; no new data or initializer.
